threads.body: [Testing] Please cover this explicit `prepare(...).query().execute(...)` path with `JDBCPool` as well, asserting that only JDBC instrumentation emits the database span. The new prepare/query advices also run for JDBC-backed connections, while the existing `VertxJdbcClientTest` only exercises `pool.query(...)`; without this case, the PR's stated suppression guarantee can regress unnoticed.

replies.body:
Addressed in 28d85c5b4724706866e4fc4b4f9617c5f0b28fbc.

Analysis: Both Vert.x version modules install the new prepare and prepared-query advice for JDBC-backed connections. Exercising JDBCPool.withConnection().prepare().query().execute() in each module and asserting exactly the parent plus one JDBC-shaped client span verifies that Vert.x instrumentation remains suppressed across the complete explicit prepare path.

Upsides: Adds regression coverage for both supported Vert.x major versions, detects duplicate Vert.x spans, and reuses one exact JDBC span assertion for simple and explicit queries.

Downsides: Adds one database operation to each JDBC test class; no material production downside identified.
